notes: Material request estimates (ST_PROJ_EST_MAST / ST_PROJ_EST_DET): serial max + 1 per store, date serial, store / date / one estimate per store and date / no later estimate, lines (item, unit, quantity > 0, basic quantity, not below the requested quantity), lines required, delete refused while the store has requests, button to copy the store's last estimate (APP_RULES3_PR). Wave 3b: legacy store / item / unit lists (units of the item as a cascading list), item name on the lines.

row_rules.ST_PROJ_EST_MAST:
-- legacy PRE-INSERT: DATE_SERIAL = max + 1 per store and date
app_rules3_pr.est_mast_row(inserting, :new.store_code, :new.est_date, :new.date_serial);

ST_PROJ_EST_MAST.STORE_CODE.lov: select store_code || ' - ' || name_a d, store_code r from st_store where store_status = 1 and nvl(stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or store_code in (select sp.store_code from st_store_password sp where sp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

ST_PROJ_EST_DET.ITEM_CODE.lov: select it.item_code || ' - ' || nvl(it.name_a, it.name_e) d, it.item_code r from st_item it where nvl(it.stop_flag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or it.item_group_code in (select gp.group_code from st_group_password gp where gp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by to_number(it.item_code)

ST_PROJ_EST_DET.UNIT_CODE.lov: select u.unit_code || ' - ' || u.name_a || decode(iu.basic_unit, 1, ' (وحدة أساسية)', '') d, u.unit_code r from st_item_unit iu, st_unit u where iu.item_code = :PAGE_ITEM_CODE and (iu.group_code = :PAGE_GROUP_CODE or :PAGE_GROUP_CODE is null) and iu.unit_code = u.unit_code order by 2

ST_PROJ_EST_DET.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_a, i.name_e)) from st_item i where i.item_code = t.item_code and i.item_group_code = t.group_code)
